title: Private Key West Sunset Sail
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Private Charter Capacities Vary by Boat. 6, 12 or Up to 32 Guests
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
2 Hr. Private charter sailing from downtown Key West onboard Key West's First sailing charter boat, the pretty green sloop "High Tide"
USCG Certified for up to 12 passengers, the Sloop High Tide and Sunset Sail Key West make for the perfect Key West sunset sail 
Peaceful, private and exclusive! 
Your captain and mate will take you out to watch the sunset from your own private classic sailing vessel, with soft drinks, bottled water and coolers stocked with ice provided for any adult beverages you choose to bring. 
Reserve ahead, there is after all, only one High Tide sunset sail per day!
Price is for up to 6 guests, 12 guests max!.
